facts.text: Through the Colby Commitment, Colby meets 100% of demonstrated financial need without loans. Families with total income of $75,000 or less and typical assets have a $0 parent contribution, while families earning up to $150,000 contribute no more than $15,000.

sources.title: The Colby Commitment - Colby College Admissions
sources.quote: If your family has a total income of $75,000 or less and typical assets, we've ensured they will have a parent or guardian contribution of $0.

facts.text: Through DavisConnects, Colby guarantees all students access to funding for research, internship, and global experiences regardless of their ability to pay.

sources.title: The Colby Commitment - Colby College Admissions
sources.quote: DavisConnects guarantees all students access to research, internship, and global experiences around the world — regardless of their ability to pay.
